steps.content: <size=45>— Act Three: Future —</size>
The enormous skirts of the dancer's dress cascade over the stage, poised to engulf the actors, all of whom have strings attached to their bodies.
The phantoms vanish without a trace. Only you and Lady Pearl are left on the stage.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're trapped in this place, more so than any of your actors.
Countless strings fall from above and attach themselves to Lady Pearl's body.
Fortuna is the never-never land that Lady Pearl has chosen for herself. She has long since been ensnared.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If every performance is as wonderful as the one unfolding before my eyes at this very moment, why would I want to leave?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I hope you can stay here with me and be my star performer.
She looks at you, an easy smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I presume you'd prefer to make your own choice.
She raises her hand. You raise yours involuntarily, as if a puppeteer has pulled a string. Your sword is now pointed squarely at Lady Pearl.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Make your choice and complete the script. How would you like the hero's journey to end?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: To seal the theater, along with the Sinner trapped in it, and leave without me...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Or to defeat me and take me away.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, have you made up your mind?
The blonde woman gazes at you with an unnerving intensity, her eyes gleaming with that familiar madness.
Make your choice now. Leave, or stay on stage to fight?
You give your answer. At the same moment, you swing out the sword. Steely light reflects off the blade, as it frees you from the bonds.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This sword is quite handy. Let me give it another whirl.
You lift the sword, this time going for the strings above Lady Pearl's head. Anticipating this, the dancer puts the enormous skirts of her dress between you and Lady Pearl.
You bring the sword down. The edge of the skirts is split open. You're getting closer and closer to Lady Pearl.
You thrust. The long blade is driven deep into the dancer's chest.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: What a graceful form...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: This... is... what I've been longing for...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You done with your lines? Then it's time to make your exit!

You sever all the strings that connect Lady Pearl with the dancer. As soon as you do so, the stage floor falls away from under you. You know this is the illusion disintegrating, and that the show is coming to an end.
You start falling. You reach out your hand, trying to grab at something.
Just before you lose consciousness, a hand catches hold of yours.
You let go of the sword. It falls onto the stage with a clang.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have a handier weapon than this sword.

The shackles are activated. Spikes sprout from your body and Lady Pearl's, and start spreading; they cling onto the strings standing in your way. By means of the shackles, you pull on the strings to inch toward Lady Pearl.
In an attempt to halt your progress by severing the link established through the shackles between you and Lady Pearl, the dancer torques the enormous skirts of her dress.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'd rather be a troublemaker destroying this stage than an actor on it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come on!

Following a sudden burst of energy, the shackles embed themselves deep in the dancer's chest. A tug-of-war between the shackles and the strings ensues. You and Lady Pearl are now in the thick of it all.
You hear the feeble sound of one string breaking, then a louder, continuous one of thousands breaking.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: What a graceful form...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: This... is... what I've been longing for...
The stage is a blur. In the confusion, you feel the floor falling away from under you. You know this is the illusion disintegrating, and that the show is coming to an end.
You start falling. You reach out your hand, trying to grab at something.
Just before you lose consciousness, a hand catches hold of yours.
Your mind is a haze. You have a vague feeling that someone is holding your hand and is leading you somewhere.
You hear music. She lifts a flap, and the music grows louder.
We've arrived, my dear.
Open your eyes.
You find yourself inside a tent standing in a far corner. In front of you, a group of performers in comical costumes are making exaggerated gestures on stage.

steps.speaker: Actor on Stage
steps.content: Music on! Let it sing you into sweet dreams...

steps.speaker: Actor on Stage
steps.content: Music on! Let it sweeten your dreams...
One performer is dressed as a king, another as queen of an enchanted forest... You see pride, elegance, grace on their expressions. They're losing themselves in their singing, their dancing.
Although the stage looks crude and the costumes have seen better days, their performance, so full of verve and vitality, draws you in almost instantly.
The show ends. Lady Pearl's voice brings you out of your reverie.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: What do you think? Does it look good?
Lady Pearl has been standing at your side this whole time. She's now smiling in the direction of the stage.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This is the original Fortuna. That was the first show I watched in Fortuna.
The performers have taken off their masks and are now giving the few front-row spectators big hugs.
Some of them look familiar. They were also in that night's performance.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: When I first struck out on my own, I was young and idealistic. I detested hypocrisy, yet at the same time, I was unsure of what I truly wanted.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Until I stumbled across this tent...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The performers were fully committed to their craft. They were playing make-believe, but few were more sincere than them in this city.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: That was what I was looking for.
Standing in the shadows, you and Lady Pearl, the two outsiders in the tent, watch as the performers wrap things up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's why you took over Fortuna.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I couldn't bear to let it go.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I kept it alive in the hope that it could bring me, again and again, that surge of elation, that quickening of the heartbeat I experienced when I watched my first show.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Alas, good shows are hard to find.

options: Is today's performance to your satisfaction?

choices.text: Is today's performance to your satisfaction?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you happy with today's performance?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Hmm...
She answers your question with one of her own.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Are you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not so bad. A bit too dangerous, though.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not as thrilling as the kind of adventure I usually go on.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Hahaha, I made the right choice by casting you in the lead.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I'm not surprised. You never let me down.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You're exceptional, kid. So exceptional, in fact, that I feel it'll be a waste to keep you here in the theater.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The time is ripe for the curtain call, but I suddenly feel reluctant to let the show end.
Shiny flakes rain down around you. In the reflected light, you see Lady Pearl's face clearly as she turns to look at you. Her face is adorned with a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then come with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since you think so highly of me, why don't you join me in my future endeavors? If you do, you'll have access to stories that are far more exciting than these.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This will be a surefire <color=#fb9259>investment</color>, just like the original Fortuna.

This woman with blonde curls shifts her gaze back to the stage. Saxophone music is swirling in the theater, but it doesn't sound melancholy; it sounds more like music that introduces the beginning of a new chapter.
Moments later, Lady Pearl opens her mouth.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: That sounds great.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I am very happy with tonight's performance. As per our agreement, I'll turn the theater over to the MBCC, leave with you and stay close to you...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: To witness your choices, your struggles, and the ending of your story.
The two of you shake hands. Red light flashes where your hands touch. The deal has been sealed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You won't be bored. This much I can guarantee.

▉Number: MBCC-S-033
▉File: Supervision Records Following the Fortuna Incident

In the aftermath of the Fortuna Incident, Sinner Lady Pearl willingly left with the Chief for the MBCC, where she was subjected to the most stringent form of restraint that the Chief's shackles can impose.

During this supervision period, the Sinner has not participated in any theater-related creative activities.

She has maintained good relations with the other Sinners in the Bureau, although, on more than one occasion, she has been caught engaging in teasing behavior that could be deemed inappropriate. When questioned, she explained that she was merely inquiring about their interest in becoming actors.
Other than that, she hasn't done anything out of line.


Judgment: The Sinner's threat level is low. In accordance with the Sinner Bail Regulations, she is hereby granted the freedom to travel outside the premises of the MBCC.

The Fortuna Theater has been taken over by the MBCC.

After the removal of the Mania contamination, the theater has been put back into use.

*Appendix:
After Lady Pearl left, the remaining members banded together to form a new troupe, and they've been performing in Fortuna.

Lady Pearl receives theater tickets from the troupe on a regular basis. Occasionally, she attends a performance in Fortuna; she arrives after the show starts and departs before the curtain call.

Chief ${PlayerName} judges this sort of behavior to be harmless and allows it to continue.

One month later
21:46
Inside the Fortuna Theater
The theater is filled to capacity, and the story is nearing its end. All eyes are trained on the stage.
A woman wearing a wide-brimmed hat is sitting by herself in the last row. She's not giving the show her full attention, drumming her fingers lightly on the armrest.
In the half-light, someone slides in and takes the seat next to her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry I'm late. Where are we in the show?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Hmm, the hero hits rock bottom, picks himself up, and defeats the dark forces. After that, he and the 108 friends he has met on his journey live happily ever after.
steps.female_content: Hmm, the heroine hits rock bottom, picks herself up, and defeats the dark forces. After that, she and the 108 friends she has met on her journey live happily ever after.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sounds so cliché. Is that really the storyline?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sounds so bizarre. Is that really the storyline?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I was joking. They haven't gotten to the end yet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, at least I get to see the ending.
You have barely finished talking when your terminal vibrates. You check it and rise from the seat, which you just took only a minute ago.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry, there's been an emergency at the Bureau, I...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Go. Don't worry about the ending. I'll recount it to you later.
You leave in a hurry, just as the story is reaching its climax, the screaming of the actor on stage drowning out your footsteps.
The woman turns her attention back to the stage. A moment later, she lowers her head.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: ...Pfft.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Hehe...
Lady Pearl chuckles.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you're such a lovely, upstanding, and innocent soul...
Unconsciously, Lady Pearl runs her fingers over her wrist where you've left a mark. The mark symbolizes the shackles you've put on her, but it is also her ticket to enter a new "theater."

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It had been ages since I conducted business in that fashion with anyone. For a moment, I thought I had lost my touch, but my worry proved ill-founded. The result is better than I thought.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I made myself a bait, yes, but it's worth it. He's worthy; I couldn't ask for a better "protagonist" than him...
steps.female_content: I made myself a bait, yes, but it's worth it. She's worthy; I couldn't ask for a better "protagonist" than her...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The curtain has fallen on the Syndicate unrest, but it's obvious to the sharp-eyed that another show, much grander in scale, awaits DisCity.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The City Council, the West District, the FAC, and that unfathomable Paradeisos... They will all come on stage to perform.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: And DisCity will be the grandiose theater for this epic show. This time, even the audience will become part of it, whether they like it or not.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Life is but a series of stories. All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It seems that I've already secured myself a front seat to the show.
The show ends. All the actors come on stage for the final curtain call. The audience gives them a standing ovation. The atmosphere is just as it was the night she first stepped into Fortuna.
It's an electrifying atmosphere of passion, sincerity...
Lady Pearl rises, joining the crowd in celebrating the actors.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The new chapter I've been looking forward to is about to start. This one will have an indefinite runtime; it ends when the curtain comes down.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I've invested everything I value in you, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Please, please don't let me down.
